adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token flow: it always `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then `await prisma.credential.update(...)` before constructing the `jsforce.Connection` (see the newly inserted block starting at `const response = await fetch(...)` through the prisma update). There is no check for token expiry, no conditional gating on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED`, and this happens whenever that connection-creation path runs, which can introduce extra outbound calls and DB writes and potential concurrent-update churn. While this is a real, diff-grounded concern (performance/architecture/regression risk), the diff alone doesn’t prove a functional correctness failure in all cases, so it’s better categorized as a non-bug but important review issue.
